meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 构建或改造UI时，它会先给出设计方案（配色、字体、布局、标志性元素），对照需求判断是否太像默认模板，必要时调整后再写代码。实现时会注重响应式与可访问性，追求风格明确、非模板化的视觉。
howto.when: 当用户要求构建新的UI或重塑现有界面的视觉设计时触发，例如做一个落地页或给已有页面改版。

say.text: 帮我新建一个产品介绍页，视觉不要像默认模板。
say.note: 它会先拿出设计方案再写代码。

say.text: 把我这个已有的个人主页重塑一下，配色和排版都更贴合内容。
say.note: 会先规划配色字体，再调整页面。

say.text: 按我贴出的设计简报，做一版作品集首页，布局要有自己的风格。
say.note: 简报中的视觉要求会被优先采用。

howto.what_en: On UI build/reshape, it drafts a design plan (palette, type, layout, signature), checks it against the brief for template defaults, adjusts, then codes. The result is deliberate, non-generic UI with responsive and accessible basics.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to build a new UI or reshape an existing interface's visual design, e.g., creating a landing page or restyling an existing page.

say_en.text: Create a product intro page, not like a generic template.
say_en.note: It will propose a design plan first, then code.

say_en.text: Reshape my personal homepage visuals; colors and type should fit the content.
say_en.note: It plans palette and type, then adjusts the page.

say_en.text: Using my pasted brief, make a portfolio homepage layout with its own character.
say_en.note: Brief instructions take priority over default styles.
